data.message: I commit to 18 tons as an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: what exact catch do you intend, and is it conditional? Assuming k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Switching10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but cuts remainder8 and low-outcome stock16. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. This isn't guaranteed best long-term. Join voluntarily.
